scripts.dev: npm run build:catalog && wrangler dev --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy
scripts.eval: npm run build:catalog --silent && vitest run --config vitest.eval.config.ts
